title: Redis/Dragonfly cache layer
objective: Cache abstraction with Redis default and Dragonfly compatibility: response cache, sessions, distributed rate-limit counters, locks, stampede prevention; cache never canonical.
acceptance_criteria: Cache integration tests pass against Redis and Dragonfly
Redis outage degrades to uncached operation (test)
Redis session cache (if enabled) falls back to PostgreSQL on Redis outage without failing open (moved from T-0019)
